replies.author: Emmaye
replies.body:
you would have to select the whole quadrant, from bottom left to top right of the map, then stand on the ground on the top right block and do //copy. Then go to the one above and rotate from the bottom right corner by doing  //rotate (degrees). Then //paste in the block your standing in, same goes for every other one, except you stand in the corner block closest to mid, hope this helps!
EDIT- This is for World Edit

replies.author: Awarrior
replies.body:
MCEdit or WorldEdit?


MCEdit steps
1: Select the region 
2: Copy the quarter
3: Paste (Doesnt matter where)
4: Rotate once  (It depends on one side or another (Make sure the water is facing the middle.
5: Import the paste after the quarter is properly set and in place
6: Paste again and rotate twice for third quadrant... and etc

WorldEdit Steps
1: Select the two positions using the wand 
2: Go to the middle
3: .//copy
4: .//rotate 90
5: //paste -a
6: Repeat the same step three times until you are done


Its easier to do it with WorldEdit and doesn't take as much time, 



Hope I helped ya :P

replies.author: Polar_Express
replies.body:
OK first do not copy and paste - when you paste your selection will be off unless your perfect.. and you will have to recopy and paste or clone and nudge after the paste....

1. Select the quad you want to move
2. select Clone
3. ( click the green nudge box and then use keys to move the selection) Nudge the cloned area into position.. you can rotate or mirror to make the quads align as you wish....
Once the clone section is in place - select clone again and it will paste the selection: Please remember  to only use the w,s,a,d,q,z keys when moving the cloned area.

I hope this helps. I use McEdit with all my maps.
